classDefaults.name: PrimaryActorTick
bOnlyRelevantToOwner
classDefaults.tooltip: If true, this actor is only relevant to its owner. If this flag is changed during play, all non-owner channels would need to be explicitly closed.

classDefaults.name: bAlwaysRelevant
classDefaults.tooltip: Always relevant for network (overrides bOnlyRelevantToOwner).

classDefaults.name: bReplicateMovement
bHidden
classDefaults.tooltip:
Allows us to only see this Actor in the Editor, and not in the actual game.
@see SetActorHiddenInGame()

classDefaults.name: bIsMainWorldOnly
classDefaults.tooltip: If checked, this Actor will only get loaded in a main world (persistent level), it will not be loaded through Level Instances.

classDefaults.name: bNetLoadOnClient
classDefaults.tooltip: This actor will be loaded on network clients during map load

classDefaults.name: bNetUseOwnerRelevancy
classDefaults.tooltip: If actor has valid Owner, call Owner's IsNetRelevantFor and GetNetPriority

classDefaults.name: bRelevantForLevelBounds
classDefaults.tooltip:
If true, this actor's component's bounds will be included in the level's
bounding box unless the Actor's class has overridden IsLevelBoundsRelevant

classDefaults.name: bReplayRewindable
classDefaults.tooltip:
If true, this actor will only be destroyed during scrubbing if the replay is set to a time before the actor existed.
Otherwise, RewindForReplay will be called if we detect the actor needs to be reset.
Note, this Actor must not be destroyed by gamecode, and RollbackViaDeletion may not be used.

classDefaults.name: bAllowTickBeforeBeginPlay
classDefaults.tooltip:
Whether we allow this Actor to tick before it receives the BeginPlay event.
Normally we don't tick actors until after BeginPlay; this setting allows this behavior to be overridden.
This Actor must be able to tick for this setting to be relevant.

classDefaults.name: bAutoDestroyWhenFinished
classDefaults.tooltip: If true then destroy self when "finished", meaning all relevant components report that they are done and no timelines or timers are in flight.

classDefaults.name: bCanBeDamaged
bBlockInput
classDefaults.tooltip: If true, all input on the stack below this actor will not be considered

classDefaults.name: bFindCameraComponentWhenViewTarget
classDefaults.tooltip: If true, this actor should search for an owned camera component to view through when used as a view target.

classDefaults.name: bGenerateOverlapEventsDuringLevelStreaming
bIgnoresOriginShifting
classDefaults.tooltip: Whether this actor should not be affected by world origin shifting.

classDefaults.name: bEnableAutoLODGeneration
classDefaults.tooltip: Whether this actor should be considered or not during HLOD generation.

classDefaults.name: bIsEditorOnlyActor
classDefaults.tooltip: Whether this actor is editor-only. Use with care, as if this actor is referenced by anything else that reference will be NULL in cooked builds

classDefaults.name: bReplicates
classDefaults.tooltip:
If true, this actor will replicate to remote machines
@see SetReplicates()

classDefaults.name: bCanBeInCluster
classDefaults.tooltip: If true, this actor can be put inside of a GC Cluster to improve Garbage Collection performance

classDefaults.name: bMigratingAsset
classDefaults.tooltip: If true, this actor can be migrated to another server even if it's been loaded from disk

classDefaults.name: bReplicateUsingRegisteredSubObjectList
classDefaults.tooltip:
When true the replication system will only replicate the registered subobjects and the replicated actor components list
When false the replication system will instead call the virtual ReplicateSubobjects() function where the subobjects and actor components need to be manually replicated.

classDefaults.name: bAsyncPhysicsTickEnabled
classDefaults.tooltip: Whether to use use the async physics tick with this actor.

classDefaults.name: UpdateOverlapsMethodDuringLevelStreaming
classDefaults.tooltip:
Condition for calling UpdateOverlaps() to initialize overlap state when loaded in during level streaming.
If set to 'UseConfigDefault', the default specified in ini (displayed in 'DefaultUpdateOverlapsMethodDuringLevelStreaming') will be used.
If overlaps are not initialized, this actor and attached components will not have an initial state of what objects are touching it,
and overlap events may only come in once one of those objects update overlaps themselves (for example when moving).
However if an object touching it *does* initialize state, both objects will know about their touching state with each other.
This can be a potentially large performance savings during level loading and streaming, and is safe if the object and others initially
overlapping it do not need the overlap state because they will not trigger overlap notifications.

Note that if 'bGenerateOverlapEventsDuringLevelStreaming' is true, overlaps are always updated in this case, but that flag
determines whether the Begin/End overlap events are triggered.

@see bGenerateOverlapEventsDuringLevelStreaming, DefaultUpdateOverlapsMethodDuringLevelStreaming, GetUpdateOverlapsMethodDuringLevelStreaming()

classDefaults.name: DefaultUpdateOverlapsMethodDuringLevelStreaming
classDefaults.tooltip:
Default value taken from config file for this class when 'UseConfigDefault' is chosen for
'UpdateOverlapsMethodDuringLevelStreaming'. This allows a default to be chosen per class in the matching config.
For example, for Actor it could be specified in DefaultEngine.ini as:

[/Script/Engine.Actor]
DefaultUpdateOverlapsMethodDuringLevelStreaming = OnlyUpdateMovable

Another subclass could set their default to something different, such as:

[/Script/Engine.BlockingVolume]
DefaultUpdateOverlapsMethodDuringLevelStreaming = NeverUpdate

@see UpdateOverlapsMethodDuringLevelStreaming

classDefaults.name: InitialLifeSpan
classDefaults.tooltip: How long this Actor lives before dying, 0=forever. Note this is the INITIAL value and should not be modified once play has begun.

classDefaults.name: CustomTimeDilation
classDefaults.tooltip: Allow each actor to run at a different time speed. The DeltaTime for a frame is multiplied by the global TimeDilation (in WorldSettings) and this CustomTimeDilation for this actor's tick.

classDefaults.name: RuntimeGrid
classDefaults.tooltip:
Determine in which partition grid this actor will be placed in the partition (if the world is partitioned).
If None, the decision will be left to the partition.

classDefaults.name: ReplicatedMovement
classDefaults.tooltip: Used for replication of our RootComponent's position and velocity

classDefaults.name: Role
classDefaults.tooltip: Describes how much control the local machine has over the actor.

classDefaults.name: NetDormancy
classDefaults.tooltip: Dormancy setting for actor to take itself off of the replication list without being destroyed on clients.

classDefaults.name: SpawnCollisionHandlingMethod
classDefaults.tooltip: Controls how to handle spawning this actor in a situation where it's colliding with something else. "Default" means AlwaysSpawn here.

classDefaults.name: AutoReceiveInput
classDefaults.tooltip: Automatically registers this actor to receive input from a player.

classDefaults.name: InputPriority
classDefaults.tooltip: The priority of this input component when pushed in to the stack.

classDefaults.name: NetPriority
classDefaults.tooltip: Priority for this actor when checking for replication in a low bandwidth or saturated situation, higher priority means it is more likely to replicate

classDefaults.name: PhysicsReplicationMode
classDefaults.tooltip: Which mode to replicate physics through for this actor. Only relevant if the actor replicates movement and has a component that simulate physics.

classDefaults.name: Instigator
classDefaults.tooltip: Pawn responsible for damage and other gameplay events caused by this actor.

classDefaults.name: RootComponent
classDefaults.tooltip: The component that defines the transform (location, rotation, scale) of this Actor in the world, all other components must be attached to this one somehow

classDefaults.name: PivotOffset
classDefaults.tooltip: Local space pivot offset for the actor, only used in the editor

classDefaults.name: HLODLayer
classDefaults.tooltip: The UHLODLayer in which this actor should be included.

classDefaults.name: Layers
classDefaults.tooltip: Layers the actor belongs to.  This is outside of the editoronly data to allow hiding of LD-specified layers at runtime for profiling.

classDefaults.name: ActorGuid
ContentBundleGuid
classDefaults.tooltip: The GUID for this actor's content bundle.

classDefaults.name: DataLayers
classDefaults.tooltip: DataLayers the actor belongs to.

classDefaults.name: DataLayerAssets
classDefaults.tooltip: DataLayers assets the actor belongs to.

classDefaults.name: SpriteScale
classDefaults.tooltip: The scale to apply to any billboard components in editor builds (happens in any WITH_EDITOR build, including non-cooked games).

classDefaults.name: bOptimizeBPComponentData
classDefaults.tooltip: Whether to cook additional data to speed up spawn events at runtime for any Blueprint classes based on this Actor. This option may slightly increase memory usage in a cooked build.

classDefaults.name: bIsSpatiallyLoaded
classDefaults.tooltip:
Determine if this actor is spatially loaded when placed in a partitioned world.
     If true, this actor will be loaded when in the range of any streaming sources and if (1) in no data layers, or (2) one or more of its data layers are enabled.
     If false, this actor will be loaded if (1) in no data layers, or (2) one or more of its data layers are enabled.

classDefaults.name: Tags
classDefaults.tooltip: Array of tags that can be used for grouping and categorizing.

properties.tooltip: Vertical text alignment

properties.tooltip: Color of the text, can be accessed as vertex color

properties.tooltip: Horizontal scale, default is 1.0

properties.name: YScale
properties.tooltip: Vertical scale, default is 1.0

properties.tooltip: Vertical size of the fonts largest character in world units. Transform, XScale and YScale will affect final size.

properties.tooltip: Horizontal adjustment per character, default is 0.0

properties.name: VertSpacingAdjust
properties.tooltip: Vertical adjustment per character, default is 0.0

properties.name: bAlwaysRenderAsText
properties.tooltip: Allows text to draw unmodified when using debug visualization modes. *

properties.name: MinDrawDistance
properties.tooltip:
The minimum distance at which the primitive should be rendered,
measured in world space units from the center of the primitive's bounding sphere to the camera position.

properties.name: LDMaxDrawDistance
properties.tooltip: Max draw distance exposed to LDs. The real max draw distance is the min (disregarding 0) of this and volumes affecting this object.

properties.name: CachedMaxDrawDistance
properties.tooltip:
The distance to cull this primitive at.
A CachedMaxDrawDistance of 0 indicates that the primitive should not be culled by distance.

properties.name: IndirectLightingCacheQuality
properties.tooltip: Quality of indirect lighting for Movable primitives.  This has a large effect on Indirect Lighting Cache update time.

properties.name: HLODBatchingPolicy
properties.tooltip: Determines how the geometry of a component will be incorporated in proxy (simplified) HLODs.

properties.name: ShadowCacheInvalidationBehavior
properties.tooltip: Control shadow invalidation behavior, in particular with respect to Virtual Shadow Maps and material effects like World Position Offset.

properties.name: bEnableAutoLODGeneration
properties.tooltip: Whether to include this component in HLODs or not.

properties.name: bNeverDistanceCull
properties.tooltip: When enabled this object will not be culled by distance. This is ignored if a child of a HLOD.

properties.name: bAlwaysCreatePhysicsState
properties.tooltip:
Indicates if we'd like to create physics state all the time (for collision and simulation).
If you set this to false, it still will create physics state if collision or simulation activated.
This can help performance if you'd like to avoid overhead of creating physics state when triggers

properties.name: bMultiBodyOverlap
properties.tooltip:
If true, this component will generate individual overlaps for each overlapping physics body if it is a multi-body component. When false, this component will
generate only one overlap, regardless of how many physics bodies it has and how many of them are overlapping another component/body. This flag has no
influence on single body components.

properties.name: bTraceComplexOnMove
bReturnMaterialOnMove
properties.tooltip:
If true, component sweeps will return the material in their hit result.
@see MoveComponent(), FHitResult

properties.name: bAllowCullDistanceVolume
properties.tooltip: Whether to accept cull distance volumes to modify cached cull distance.

properties.name: bVisibleInReflectionCaptures
properties.tooltip: If true, this component will be visible in reflection captures.

properties.name: bVisibleInRealTimeSkyCaptures
properties.tooltip: If true, this component will be visible in real-time sky light reflection captures.

properties.name: bVisibleInRayTracing
properties.tooltip: If true, this component will be visible in ray tracing effects. Turning this off will remove it from ray traced reflections, shadows, etc.

properties.name: bRenderInMainPass
properties.tooltip: If true, this component will be rendered in the main pass (z prepass, basepass, transparency)

properties.name: bRenderInDepthPass
properties.tooltip: If true, this component will be rendered in the depth pass even if it's not rendered in the main pass

properties.name: bReceivesDecals
properties.tooltip: Whether the primitive receives decals.

properties.name: bHoldout
properties.tooltip: If this is True, this primitive will render black with an alpha of 0, but all secondary effects (shadows, reflections, indirect lighting) remain. This feature requires activating the project setting(s) "Alpha Output", and "Support Primitive Alpha Holdout" if using the deferred renderer.

properties.name: bOwnerNoSee
properties.tooltip: If this is True, this component won't be visible when the view actor is the component's owner, directly or indirectly. Will be internally set to true when FirstPersonPrimitiveType is set to WorldSpaceRepresentation.

properties.name: bOnlyOwnerSee
properties.tooltip: If this is True, this component will only be visible when the view actor is the component's owner, directly or indirectly.

properties.name: bTreatAsBackgroundForOcclusion
properties.tooltip: Treat this primitive as part of the background for occlusion purposes. This can be used as an optimization to reduce the cost of rendering skyboxes, large ground planes that are part of the vista, etc.

properties.name: bUseAsOccluder
bConsiderForActorPlacementWhenHidden
properties.tooltip: If true, this component will be considered for placement when dragging and placing items in the editor even if it is not visible, such as in the case of hidden collision meshes

properties.name: bForceMipStreaming
properties.tooltip: If true, forces mips for textures used by this component to be resident when this component's level is loaded.

properties.name: bHasPerInstanceHitProxies
properties.tooltip:
If true a hit-proxy will be generated for each instance of instanced static meshes.
This allows for other systems, like selection in viewports, to function at the individual instance.

properties.name: CastShadow
properties.tooltip: Controls whether the primitive component should cast a shadow or not.

properties.name: bEmissiveLightSource
properties.tooltip: Whether the primitive will be used as an emissive light source.

properties.name: bAffectDynamicIndirectLighting
properties.tooltip: Controls whether the primitive should influence indirect lighting.

properties.name: bAffectIndirectLightingWhileHidden
properties.tooltip: Controls whether the primitive should affect indirect lighting when hidden. This flag is only used if bAffectDynamicIndirectLighting is true.

properties.name: bAffectDistanceFieldLighting
properties.tooltip: Controls whether the primitive should affect dynamic distance field lighting methods.  This flag is only used if CastShadow is true.

properties.name: bCastDynamicShadow
properties.tooltip: Controls whether the primitive should cast shadows in the case of non precomputed shadowing. This flag is only used if CastShadow is true and if FirstPersonPrimitiveType is not set to FirstPerson.

properties.name: bCastStaticShadow
properties.tooltip: Whether the object should cast a static shadow from shadow casting lights. This flag is only used if CastShadow is true and if FirstPersonPrimitiveType is not set to FirstPerson.

properties.name: bCastVolumetricTranslucentShadow
properties.tooltip:
Whether the object should cast a volumetric translucent shadow.
Volumetric translucent shadows are useful for primitives with smoothly changing opacity like particles representing a volume,
but have artifacts when used on highly opaque surfaces. This flag is only used if CastShadow is true and if FirstPersonPrimitiveType is not set to FirstPerson.

properties.name: bCastContactShadow
properties.tooltip:
Whether the object should cast contact shadows.
This flag is only used if CastShadow is true.

properties.name: bSelfShadowOnly
properties.tooltip:
When enabled, the component will only cast a shadow on itself and not other components in the world.
This is especially useful for first person weapons, and forces bCastInsetShadow to be enabled.

properties.name: bCastFarShadow
properties.tooltip: When enabled, the component will be rendering into the far shadow cascades (only for directional lights). This flag is only used if CastShadow is true and if FirstPersonPrimitiveType is not set to FirstPerson.

properties.name: bCastInsetShadow
properties.tooltip:
Whether this component should create a per-object shadow that gives higher effective shadow resolution.
Useful for cinematic character shadowing. Assumed to be enabled if bSelfShadowOnly is enabled.

properties.name: bCastCinematicShadow
properties.tooltip:
Whether this component should cast shadows from lights that have bCastShadowsFromCinematicObjectsOnly enabled.
This is useful for characters in a cinematic with special cinematic lights, where the cost of shadowmap rendering of the environment is undesired.

properties.name: bCastHiddenShadow
properties.tooltip:
If true, the primitive will cast shadows even if bHidden is true.
Controls whether the primitive should cast shadows when hidden.
This flag is only used if CastShadow is true and if FirstPersonPrimitiveType is not set to WorldSpaceRepresentation.

properties.name: bCastShadowAsTwoSided
properties.tooltip: Whether this primitive should cast dynamic shadows as if it were a two sided material.

properties.name: bLightAttachmentsAsGroup
properties.tooltip:
Whether to light this component and any attachments as a group.  This only has effect on the root component of an attachment tree.
When enabled, attached component shadowing settings like bCastInsetShadow, bCastVolumetricTranslucentShadow, etc, will be ignored.
This is useful for improving performance when multiple movable components are attached together.

properties.name: bExcludeFromLightAttachmentGroup
properties.tooltip: If set, then it overrides any bLightAttachmentsAsGroup set in a parent.

properties.name: bReceiveMobileCSMShadows
properties.tooltip:
Mobile only:
If disabled this component will not receive CSM shadows. (Components that do not receive CSM may have reduced shading cost)

properties.name: bSingleSampleShadowFromStationaryLights
properties.tooltip:
Whether the whole component should be shadowed as one from stationary lights, which makes shadow receiving much cheaper.
When enabled shadowing data comes from the volume lighting samples precomputed by Lightmass, which are very sparse.
This is currently only used on stationary directional lights.

properties.name: bIgnoreRadialImpulse
properties.tooltip: Will ignore radial impulses applied to this component.

properties.name: bIgnoreRadialForce
properties.tooltip: Will ignore radial forces applied to this component.

properties.name: bApplyImpulseOnDamage
properties.tooltip: True for damage to this component to apply physics impulse, false to opt out of these impulses.

properties.name: bReplicatePhysicsToAutonomousProxy
properties.tooltip:
True if physics should be replicated to autonomous proxies. This should be true for
              server-authoritative simulations, and false for client authoritative simulations.

properties.name: bFillCollisionUnderneathForNavmesh
properties.tooltip: If set, navmesh will not be generated under the surface of the geometry

properties.name: bRasterizeAsFilledConvexVolume
properties.tooltip:
If set, the geometry gathered for navigation data generation will be converted into a filled vertical convex volume.
It means that all collision geometries of the asset are merged vertically resulting in a grid of vertical columns that encompass the asset.
This can be useful to represent the interior of the surface and prevent navmesh inside.

properties.name: bRenderCustomDepth
properties.tooltip: If true, this component will be rendered in the CustomDepth pass (usually used for outlines)

properties.name: bVisibleInSceneCaptureOnly
properties.tooltip: When true, will only be visible in Scene Capture

properties.name: bHiddenInSceneCapture
properties.tooltip: When true, will not be captured by Scene Capture

properties.name: FirstPersonPrimitiveType
properties.tooltip: If this is set to FirstPerson, the camera FirstPersonFieldOfView and FirstPersonScale parameters will be used on this component. These parameters can be used to render the component with a different field of view and a smaller depth range such that clipping with the scene can be avoided. This is useful for rendering first person view geometry.

properties.name: bStaticWhenNotMoveable
properties.tooltip: When false, the underlying physics body will contain all sim data (mass, inertia tensor, etc) even if mobility is not set to Moveable

properties.name: CanCharacterStepUpOn
LightingChannels
properties.tooltip:
Channels that this component should be in.  Lights with matching channels will affect the component.
These channels only apply to opaque materials, direct lighting, and dynamic lighting and shadowing.
Lighting channels are only supported on translucent materials using forward shading (i.e. when not using the translucency lighting volume).

properties.name: RayTracingGroupCullingPriority
properties.tooltip: Defines how quickly it should be culled. For example buildings should have a low priority, but small dressing should have a high priority.

properties.name: CustomDepthStencilWriteMask
properties.tooltip: Mask used for stencil buffer writes.

properties.name: ExcludeFromHLODLevels
properties.tooltip: Which specific HLOD levels this component should be excluded from

properties.name: RayTracingGroupId
properties.tooltip:
Defines run-time groups of components. For example allows to assemble multiple parts of a building at runtime.
-1 means that component doesn't belong to any group.

properties.name: CustomDepthStencilValue
properties.tooltip: Optionally write this 0-255 value to the stencil buffer in CustomDepth pass (Requires project setting or r.CustomDepth == 3)

properties.name: CustomPrimitiveData
properties.tooltip: Optional user defined default values for the custom primitive data of this primitive

properties.name: TranslucencySortPriority
properties.tooltip:
Translucent objects with a lower sort priority draw behind objects with a higher priority.
Translucent objects with the same priority are rendered from back-to-front based on their bounds origin.
This setting is also used to sort objects being drawn into a runtime virtual texture.

Ignored if the object is not translucent.  The default priority is zero.
Warning: This should never be set to a non-default value unless you know what you are doing, as it will prevent the renderer from sorting correctly.
It is especially problematic on dynamic gameplay effects.

properties.name: TranslucencySortDistanceOffset
properties.tooltip:
Modified sort distance offset for translucent objects in world units.
A positive number will move the sort distance further and a negative number will move the distance closer.

Ignored if the object is not translucent.
Warning: Adjusting this value will prevent the renderer from correctly sorting based on distance.  Only modify this value if you are certain it will not cause visual artifacts.

properties.name: RuntimeVirtualTextures
properties.tooltip:
Array of runtime virtual textures into which we draw the mesh for this actor.
The material also needs to be set up to output to a virtual texture.

properties.name: VirtualTextureLodBias
properties.tooltip: Bias to the LOD selected for rendering to runtime virtual textures.

properties.name: VirtualTextureCullMips
properties.tooltip:
Number of lower mips in the runtime virtual texture to skip for rendering this primitive.
Larger values reduce the effective draw distance in the runtime virtual texture.
This culling method doesn't take into account primitive size or virtual texture size.

properties.name: VirtualTextureMinCoverage
properties.tooltip:
Set the minimum pixel coverage before culling from the runtime virtual texture.
Larger values reduce the effective draw distance in the runtime virtual texture.

properties.name: VirtualTextureRenderPassType
properties.tooltip: Controls if this component draws in the main pass as well as in the virtual texture.

properties.name: BoundsScale
properties.tooltip:
Scales the bounds of the object.
This is useful when using World Position Offset to animate the vertices of the object outside of its bounds.
Warning: Increasing the bounds of an object will reduce performance and shadow quality!
Currently only used by StaticMeshComponent and SkeletalMeshComponent.

properties.tooltip: Physics scene information for this component, holds a single rigid body with multiple shapes.
